title: Levin voltage series — the machine-readable deep mine of published planarian (and adjacent-model) Vmem measurements
protocol: mined from the repo's own artifacts (PlanformDB 2.5.0 rows via direct SQL; results/exp39_levin_voltage.json; research corpus) + targeted Europe PMC abstract/full-text retrieval and web search this session (raw fetches in /tmp/levin_series); NO experiments run, NO existing files modified
honest_scope: Zero absolute mV values are published for planarian tissues in 70+ years (Marsh-Beams 1952 -> 2026); the planarian record is DiBAC4(3) RELATIVE polarities + outcome frequencies + timing kernels. vmem_mv is null for every planarian row.
Absolute values exist only in adjacent models (Xenopus: -19.4 mV impalement delta, C11) and in the lab's own simulator (BETSE band, C13).

PlanformDB ExperimentDrug carries NO concentrations (exp33's L16 finding); drug start/end are times under exp33's registered hours-reading — unit ambiguity for the Oviedo 2010 Fig 2A kernel is owned in research/levin_voltage_series.md (T1).
Durant 2019's per-arm double-headed percentages are paywalled (abstract-level only); the 3 h/6 h hooks are verified.
Emmons-Bell 2015's per-species head-shape frequencies live in figures, not text (100% control fidelity + 123 uM dose verified from text).
Molano single-author bioRxiv barium preprints (2023/2024, non-peer-reviewed) were NOT resolvable this session beyond subagent 2-b's deposit note; excluded from the series.

stack_constants_for_targets.two_channel_law_exp84: err = sqrt(eV^2 + eT^2); writability boundary < 6.0 mV (Spearman 0.999, median rel err 2.7%)
stack_constants_for_targets.mu_silence_deadline_exp120_124: torus D(gamma): gamma1 never rescues, gamma4 -> 48 h, gamma16 -> 72 h, gamma64 -> 36 h; mu doubling 48 -> 36 -> 12 h; conjunctive (both channels must be cut, exp123); analytic rate per mode = mu*lambda + eps*gamma*lambda/(gamma + g*lambda)
stack_constants_for_targets.dose_axes_exp91_92: amplitude axis d: threshold between 0.25 and 0.5, graded window d in [0.35, 0.45] (3/7 rate at 0.40); decoded corpus MAE 0.290 mV
stack_constants_for_targets.exp54_write_window: 3 h pulse at t=0 writes 3.00 mV; any later start ~0.5 mV; 12 h start = 0; 3 h sufficiency ratio 0.91
